messages:
sophia: Quick proposal — for the upcoming ship window we need to trim features to keep the MVP stable. Suggest cutting: 1) Tenant SSO provisioning UI, 2) In-console A/B rollout control, 3) Advanced token-level billing dashboard. Keep: API parity, devx quickstarts, core routing/fallbacks. Need sign-off by EOD Friday. Thoughts?

mike: +1 on cutting the billing dashboard. It's been blocking infra work and is high effort. Removing it buys us time.

ana: Sales check — we have three active POCs that expect SSO in the console. If we cut the full UI, demos break. Is a compromise possible?

ravi: We could implement a barebones 'connect' flow (redirect + token exchange) + docs. Engineering effort ~3 days. No full provisioning UI.

jules: Design can ship stripped-down wireframes for the connect CTA and one-page flow today. Minimal copy, single success state.

pm-bot: FYI release-blockers report updated: https://redwood.internal/release/197862 — billing dashboard flagged as "deferred candidate".

sophia: If the 'connect' flow is ~3d and supports demos, I'm OK keeping that. Still need a decision on deferring A/B controls to v1 — A/B is infra-heavy.

mike: Defer A/B to v1. It requires rollout hooks and can complicate our canary policies.

ana: OK on A/B deferral if SSO 'connect' exists for demos. Sales will notify POCs about partial support.

ravi: For billing, we can ship a CSV export + basic usage numbers in the console as a stopgap. Full dashboard moves to v1.

jules: Design checklist for MVP: connect CTA, success/error states, CSV export UI, update onboarding modal. I'll post quick mocks in #design.

sophia: Updated acceptance criteria for MVP: - API endpoints stable and documented - Basic SSO connect flow (minimal UX) - CSV export for billing data - No A/B controls in MVP - Rollout fallback policies tested. Target ship date remains 2025-10-15.

mike: Risk callout — to keep the ship date we need a code freeze for non-critical changes by next Tue. I'll schedule the freeze window and call out exceptions.

ana: Sales will align messaging: full SSO admin console = v1, but connect button supports demos and early POCs.

devex: Need to update quickstarts and the sample configs to show the connect flow and CSV download. ETA 2 days.

ops-bot: Scheduled smoke test run: 2025-09-30 22:00 UTC.

ravi: One more ask — recommend a 5% canary rollout for the new SSO connect flow to monitor errors. Low blast radius, easy rollback.

sophia: Agree on 5% canary. Add to rollout plan and make sure the fallback policy triggers on 5xx spike or latency > 500ms. I'll update the roadmap and publish a cut-decision doc after this thread. Thanks all.

jules: :thumbsup:

mike: :thumbsup:

ana: Thanks — I'll update sales enablement notes and notify POCs.
